Foods that are Moderate or Low Sources of Purines
Beef, lamb, pork (steak or chops), bacon, ham, sausages, some poultry, tongue (all should be eaten in moderation)
Carrots, parsnip, other root vegetables, potatoes, lettuce, leeks, cabbage, sprouts, marrow, squash, courgettes
Peanuts, cashew nuts
Breakfast cereals
Some ﬁsh (see Table 2)
Foods and Beverages that are Essentially Purine-Free
Milk, cheese, eggs, butter, margarine, cream, ice cream
White bread or ﬂour, cakes, scones, biscuits
Sugar, jam, marmalade, honey, and sweets
Cucumber, tomato, onions, pumpkin
Fresh, cooked or tinned fruits, nuts
Puddings, custards, yogurt
Fruit juices, soft drinks
